During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' officer was stationed on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] as Commander [[Rilan]]'s lieutenant, and led one of his [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commando]] teams on a mission to investigate the unusual beasts' behavior on the planet's jungles. The mission failed and the officer, along with his team, were killed by the beasts.
